title: environment.v1
description: Where this machine keeps the plugins the slots name, so the ASPICE Agent can load and run them. Owned by the person, never committed: <product>/.qf/environment.yaml for a project-scoped setup, ~/.config/quality-framework/environment.yaml for a per-user one (the first found counts). Without it, the conventional skill folders are searched. Paths may start with ~; relative paths are relative to the file.

skill_dirs.description: Folders holding one sub-folder per skill (<dir>/<skill>/SKILL.md), searched in order before the conventional ones.

plugins.description: Skills installed somewhere special: skill name → its SKILL.md.
